name: Copilot Content Block
title: Sales Performance
description: Interactive sales dashboard. FY26 January to August, 100 orders. Total revenue 2.77 crore rupees with 68.1 percent blended margin; gross profit 1.89 crore across 697 units. Best month April at 0.57 crore; top category Software at 1.33 crore and 77.7 percent margin; average order 2.77 lakh. A toggleable bar chart breaks revenue, profit or units down by country, category, channel, product or salesperson. A line chart shows monthly revenue and profit peaking in April and dipping in May. A leaderboard table ranks the top five salespeople by revenue, led by Priyanka at 0.53 crore. Channel split: Direct 1.03 crore, Partner 0.88 crore, Online 0.86 crore.
